configurationMatrix.name: output
configurationMatrix.rule: CLI resolves absolute output directory; generated paths remain relative to schema root.

configurationMatrix.name: indentationSize
configurationMatrix.rule: Preserve exact spaces and formatting in TS/config and CLI side effects; metadata JSON remains in the original serialization format.

configurationMatrix.name: uniqueNamePropertyName
configurationMatrix.rule: Constructor null/undefined coalesces to _name. Preserve the custom property across interfaces, guards, defaults and updates. CLI help says undefined but runtime default is _name.

configurationMatrix.name: typeScriptConfiguration
configurationMatrix.rule: With --no-ts-config no tsconfig is emitted; programmatic null/undefined suppresses it. Preserve generated include order and supplied config merge/serialization.

configurationMatrix.name: extends
configurationMatrix.rule: Resolve input against cwd and emit original relative path from output; compilation and known-report variants are tracked by VQ-45.

configurationMatrix.name: sortProperties
configurationMatrix.rule: Preserve source order when false and original sorting semantics when true, across imported schemas, emitted code, metadata and CRCs.

configurationMatrix.name: mainFile
configurationMatrix.rule: Required readable schema file; preserve root-relative paths and import resolution.

configurationMatrix.name: help
configurationMatrix.rule: Preserve public CLI behavior, with any help/default corrections recorded explicitly.

configurationMatrix.name: programmatic options
configurationMatrix.rule: Record programmatic configuration separately from CLI defaults; outDir must be absolute. Native metadata generation receives all required configuration explicitly.
